MPs booked for Ram temple donation skit in Parliament

Police in Varanasi have filed an FIR against opposition MPs Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav, and Awadhesh Prasad. The complaint alleges they insulted Sanatan Dharma during a skit performed in Parliament concerning Ram temple donations. The skit reportedly mocked the theft of donations. Congress has defended the MPs' actions.
